summary: Moved all date/time parsing and building into the new deskstats/timeparse.py (parse_offset, parse_instant, from_epoch, parse_day, at_clock, day_start) as docs/timeparse.md specifies. The other modules delegate to it and keep their public functions. All 31 tests pass, including the new tests/test_timeparse.py. A fuzz comparison against the original package found no differences. A CLI comparison over 4200 runs (commands, formats, options, machine time zones) found the same stdout and exit status; the only difference was the traceback frames of inputs that already crashed. Quirks kept as they are, not fixed: unpadded and negative two-digit years in roster dates (-1 becomes 1999); a year or hour too large for a C int, or an infinite timestamp, still crashes the run instead of giving a clean error; truncation toward zero for calls and half-to-even rounding for chats.
